mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS name, COUNT(at.id) AS articleCount FROM article_tag at JOIN article a ON a.id = at.article_id JOIN tag t ON t.id = at.tag_id WHERE a.state = #{state} AND a.deleted = #{deleted} GROUP BY t.id, t.name HAVING COUNT(at.id) > 0 ORDER BY articleCount DESC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
